title: All-q Levi apartment incidence kernel and cycle-space tight frame
purpose: Extend Pass5388-5395 from the abstract Hodge idempotent to the explicit matrix of all oriented Levi 8-cycle apartments. Count apartment completions through pairs of flag edges, prove the signed overlap law (-1)^d q^(4-d), derive C C^T=N E_-2, count all apartments, and recover the q=3 160x1620 cycle-frame theorem as an exact specialization.

targets.5396: apartment count through one flag edge and total apartment census
targets.5397: pair completion count q^(4-d) by flag-linegraph distance
targets.5399: matrix identity C C^T=N E_-2 and tight-frame theorem
targets.5400: normalized apartment frame parameters and q=3 BT545-BT549 recovery
targets.5401: independent symbolic/combinatorial verifier and finite-q anchors

boundary: Do not claim that arbitrary selected apartment subsets form tight frames; the theorem concerns the full set of simple Levi 8-cycles with consistent edge orientation. Do not infer quantum-code distance or physical fault tolerance from the frame identity alone. Check prior art before claiming novelty beyond the repo bridge.
